newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTAN STOCKS END DOWN ON SETTLEMENT DAY.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTAN STOCKS END DOWN ON SETTLEMENT DAY.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Tuesday on heavy position-squaring by small investors on settlement day and dealers said the index would slide more as the market was over-bought.
"The index tumbled as weak holders squared their positions on settlement day," dealer Hasan Dawar said. "Blue chips are over-bought and the index could slip further."
The index fell 30.16 points, or 1.51 percent, to end at 1,972.77. Losers led gainers 203 to 31. Hub Power fell 0.70 rupees to 52.50 and PTCL 0.55 to 43.60.
